## Ingredients

* 2 Tbsp of neutral oil (vegetable, canola, etc)
* 1 lb of rinsed white rice
* 1 yellow onion, chopped fine
* 4 cloves of garlic (4 tsp jarlic)
* 1 large carrot, diced fine or shredded
* 8 oz of canned corn (or 1/2 normal sized can of corn (15 oz))
* 8 oz of tomato sauce
* 4 cups of vegetable or chicken broth
* 1 Tbsp of chicken bullion powder
* cilantro

## Directions

* Finely chop the yellow onion
* Add the **2 Tbsp** of neutral oil to a warmish pain
* Add the onion and **4 cloves** of garlic in a pan, until translucent
* Add **1 lb** of rinsed white rice and toast slightly, 5 to 10 min
* Add the **8 oz** of tomato sauce
* Add **3 - 4 cups** of vegetable broth
* Add **1 Tbsp** chicken bullion powder
* Add finely diced or shredded carrots and **8 oz** of corn on top
* Sprinkle with dried or fresh cilantro
* Cover, allow it to come to a boil, and then cook on low for 20 minutes

Source: [Ian Fujimoto](https://ianfujimoto.substack.com/p/how-to-feed-your-family-on-a-budget)
